evidence.reason: The stdin scan at line 117 relies on gitleaks' default inline-allow behavior, so a commit message or diff line containing both a secret and `gitleaks:allow` can suppress the finding. That lets scanned head content override the trusted denylist, contrary to the fail-closed denylist requirement and the workflow's existing intent to stop scanned revisions from controlling diff output (lines 102-105). Add `--ignore-gitleaks-allow` to this invocation and the two git invocations at lines 106 and 109. This is a routine correctness/security fix, not a new requirement.
